primary_question: Is FincoGPT now meaningfully testable by another internal finance user as an exploratory modelling tool for Generic Solar / Generic Wind projects?

evidence: 16 input fields exposed (project name, technology, capacity MW, COD, construction months, horizon years, total CAPEX, P50 hours, PPA tariff, PPA term, OPEX Y1, gearing, interest rate, tenor, target DSCR, country_market)
financial outputs change proportionally to the edits
compare_scenarios builds 10 metric rows + 2 governance rows with delta
5+ export cards visible (workbook, calibration, runtime, parity, gap, source, governance)
inputs_section.html has inp-exploratory-notice with EXPLORATORY badge + safety copy
pilot_limitations_notice.html lists Generic projects as 'not yet validated against Excel'
pilot_workflow_guide.html Step 1 says 'generic is exploratory only'
safety copy is complete: lender-ready / audit-ready / bank-approved / Excel-parity / artefact / internal sketching
badge style is badge-warn (not blocked, not convention)
factory read-only notice in inputs_section (inp-readonly-notice + {% if not is_user_project %})
factory seeded path uses create_default_tuho_wind1 / create_default_oborovo (app/services/run_service.py)
construction flag still defaults to False (app/waterfall_core.py)

q10_what_still_prevents_fully_working_in.answer: 6 documented gaps: (1) no Excel-parity validation for generic, (2) no CO2 / certificates / balancing parity, (3) no sculpting / live debt-sizing, (4) no senior IDC resolution, (5) no construction runtime / C10, (6) no PDF export.
evidence: 24-H hard constraints explicitly exclude C10 / R-PAR / construction promotion

Generic projects do not include CO2 / certificates / balancing parity
Generic projects use fixed-shape debt schedule (not min_DSCR-sized)
Generic projects use simplified IDC (not R-PAR-2)
Generic projects use fixture-backed waterfall (not live construction)

scope.item: 'What changed' delta indicator in runtime summary

honest_summary.achieved: FincoGPT is now meaningfully testable as a Generic Solar / Generic Wind exploratory modelling tool. A finance user can create a Generic project, edit inputs, save a Base case, add Downside / Upside scenarios, run all three, compare any two, and export / download an XLSX.
honest_summary.not_achieved: Generic outputs are not Excel-parity validated. The senior debt schedule, CO2 / certificates / balancing, IDC, and construction runtime are still fixture-backed from the TUHO / Oborovo reference. A user who treats a generic project output as a 'bank-ready' result will be misled -- the EXPLORATORY warning exists precisely to prevent that.
can_confidently_use_for_today: Internal screening ('if the tariff is 90 vs 130, what's the IRR?')
Capacity / sizing sketches ('if we go from 50 MW to 75 MW, what's the impact on DSCR?')
Sensitivity tables ('if opex rises 20%, what happens to distributions?')
